title: Indicator Fourier coefficients
statement: In the uniform probability space on $\{a,b,c\}$, let the indicator of $c$ be $1$ at $c$ and $0$ at $a,b$. Its coefficient against the $j$th vector of the specified three-point orthonormal basis is $1/3$ for $j=0$, $-\sqrt{2}/6$ for $j=1$, and $-\sqrt{6}/6$ for $j=2$.
